name: Five Spice Meatball & Cabbage Soup
steps: Start by roughly chopping the cabbage. Cut the ginger into thin matchsticks then grate the garlic. Finely chop the chives.
Add the cabbage, meatballs, five spice, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, chives and beef stock to a Tupperware before transferring to the freezer.
Once ready you're ready to cook, transfer the frozen contents of the Tupperware into a saucepan over a medium heat. Cover with a lid and allow to melt before gently simmering for 10 minutes.
Once the meatballs are cooked through, serve up and top with a drizzle of crispy chilli oil.
